exposure: Monocryl 3-0 subcuticular for skin closure in Cesarean sections
outcome: Wound complications (seroma, infection, dehiscence, hypertrophic scar, hematoma) at 6 weeks
Cosmetic scar assessment (POSAS score) at 6 weeks
cohort: Cases admitted in an obstetric department undergoing Cesarean section between January 2023 and March 2024.
finding: The study found a mean pain score of 5.05 at postoperative day 5, and at 6 weeks, observed seroma in 6%, infection in 3.3%, dehiscence in 3.3%, and hypertrophic scar in 2% of cases, with mean patient and observer scar scores around 6.1.
